messages:
cara-sales: Hey team, starting a new POC thread for Nebula Health. They want a billing project, 150k promo tokens, hard spend cap at $500 for the trial, ephemeral API keys for 4 engineers, and optional Dedicated pool for stress tests. Can we run through the provisioning steps?

leo-solutions: Quick recap from the call: Nebula will test embeddings + chat at scale. They want keys that expire, scoped to the POC project, and an assurance they won't be charged > $500 during the POC. They'll also ask for a short Dedicated window with VPC private endpoint access.

ravi-infra: We can create a trial billing project under sales: r-17341-nebula-poc. Default quota is 25k tokens, so we'll need to bump to 150k. For ephemeral keys we usually mint 8h TTL keys for devs and a 48h TTL for the CI runner if needed. Need the engineer emails to provision service accounts.

sophia-finance: Do we want to apply the 150k as promo credits or as a prepaid internal charge? Promo credits are fine, but ask whether they need invoices for accounting. Also, a hard spend cap of $500 requires a spend-shield policy. I can apply that and set notification emails.

infra-bot: provisioning-bot: created project r-17341-nebula-poc (id: r-17341) with default_quota=25000 at 1734123501.

leo-solutions: infra-bot shows 25k default — Sophia can you bump to 150k? Cara, get me the 4 emails and the CI service account name.

sophia-finance: I can top-up credits to 150k tokens and apply spendcap=500 USD hard block. Who should get the billing alerts?

cara-sales: Send alerts to nebula-poc@nebulahealth.com plus sales-billing@sales. I will DM the emails.

ada-security: Small security note: for private endpoints we require an IP allowlist and the customer's VPC CIDR. For Dedicated with VPC peering we need the SOC2 excerpts and network diagram. For a short POC window we can do a private endpoint + mutual TLS route instead of full peering. Also need to confirm that their CI runner will not store long-lived keys.

ravi-infra: Recommended SA layout: poc-dev1, poc-dev2, poc-dev3, poc-dev4 (engineer write access), poc-ci (read+invoke). Example commands:
```
# create service account
rctl iam svc create poc-dev1 --project r-17341
# mint ephemeral key (8h)
rctl auth ephemeral-mint --svc poc-dev1 --ttl 8h --scope project:r-17341
```
I'll push the keys to the secure share and tag the audit entries.

infra-bot: audit-bot: audit record created for project r-17341 by ravi-infra at 1734123602.

sophia-finance: Credits applied: promo_tokens=150000, spendcap=500 USD hard. Alerts set to nebula-poc@nebulahealth.com, sales-billing@sales, finance@sales at 50/80/100%.

leo-solutions: On Dedicated access: we can offer a complimentary 72-hour Dedicated trial slot for stress testing (subject to capacity). After that, we'll either bill at the documented trial rate or schedule reserved hours. Cara, confirm if we want to include the complimentary Dedicated window in the SOW.

cara-sales: Yes, include the 72-hour complimentary Dedicated window. Also confirm VPC approach: recommend private endpoint + IP allowlist first, escalate to peering only if they require low-latency passthrough.

ada-security: Agreed. I'll sign off on private endpoints for the POC if they provide the CIDR(s) and complete the network section of the questionnaire. If they insist on peering we require a security intake + tunnel ticket.

ravi-infra: Timeline: service accounts + ephemeral keys provisioned same day once emails received; credits & spendcap done; Dedicated slot needs 3 business days lead for tenant allocation if we can't fit in slack capacity.

leo-solutions: Action items: 1) @cara-sales collect emails and DM to @ravi-infra; 2) @sophia-finance apply promo credits and spend cap (in progress); 3) @ada-security review network Qs once I attach draft; 4) @ravi-infra provision SAs and post key share link.

cara-sales: I'll DM the emails now. Thanks everyone — I'll update the thread when keys are live and when the SOW is updated. :pray:
